$sources: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.10 (pp. 987-992): precast concrete: loading from fabrication to end use (6.10.2.1), structural integrity ties (6.10.5), bearing (6.10.6.2), handling (6.10.9)

SAEngine practice where BNBC 2020 Sec 6.10.2.1 and 6.10.9.1 ask for the handling and erection stages and give no values: PCI Design Handbook (8th ed.) handling multipliers and Mast's hanging beam stability; see VERIFY.md

sources.bearing: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.10.6.2.2(a)-(b) (p. 991): seating at least ln/180 and 50 mm (solid or hollow-core slabs), 75 mm (beams, stemmed members); pads set back 13 mm from unarmoured edges; Sec 6.10.6.2.1 and 6.3.14: bearing 0.85 f'c A1, phi of the factors table (bearing)
sources.dowel: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.10.6.1.1 (p. 990): connections by analysis or test, shear by Sec 6.4.5 (shear friction)
sources.connections.tensionShare: SAEngine practice: the least horizontal tension 0.2 Vu of a corbel's bearing (BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.4.7.3.4) taken for every bearing of a precast piece where none is entered
sources.integrity: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.10.5.1.2-6.10.5.1.3 and 6.10.5.2.1-6.10.5.2.5 (pp. 988-990): 4.4 kN/m diaphragm connections, columns 1.4 Ag [N], two ties of 44 kN per wall panel; bearing wall structures of 3 storeys or more: floor ties 22 kN/m at most 3 m apart, perimeter tie 71 kN within 1.2 m of the edge, vertical ties 44 kN/m
sources.handling: SAEngine practice where BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.10.9.1 gives no values: PCI Design Handbook 8th ed. equivalent static multipliers (stripping by mould and finish, smooth form column; yard 1.2, travel 1.5, erection 1.2), cracking tension 0.62 sqrt(f'ci) / 1.5, insert safety factor 4; f'ci = 0.7 f'c when not entered; four-point rigid rigging on two inserts
sources.erection: SAEngine practice where BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 6.10.9.2 asks for bracing and gives no values: erection wind 0.5 kPa, safety 1.5 against overturning; hanging members by Mast (PCI Journal 1989, 1993): FS = yr / (zo + ei) at least 1.5, sweep L/960, insert tolerance 6 mm
